Maya: Quick draft — launching a 'Launchpad Sparknotes' one-pager + 2-slide field card + webinar blurb. Goal: give AE/SE an easy routing + benchmark narrative. Need copy + mockups by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:

Tomas: I'll take SLAs & security. Want me to call out SOC2, KMS, VPC peering, FedRAMP consideration?

Jen: Uploaded initial one-pager bullets -> https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbCdefG (org access). Short bullets:
- What: unified inference across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
- Why: predictable latency & cost controls
- Who: platform + security-first customers
- CTA: request a field demo

Jen: Also mockups in Figma: https://figma.com/file/Launchpad

Priyanka: Webinar blurb idea: “How to go from PoC to production: latency SLAs, cost levers, and routing playbooks.” 20-min talk + 10-min Q&A. Demo hooks: 1) live route failover, 2) cost tuning w/ batching.

Maya: Assigning owners: Tomas -> SLA/security bullets; Jen -> one-pager visual + field card; Priyanka -> webinar blurb + 30s elevator; Maya -> benchmark narrative & perf numbers. I'll consolidate.

Tomas: Quick Q: Do we mention Dedicated pricing tiers or keep it qualitative?

Maya: Keep it qualitative: 'Reserved capacity with predictable throughput' — avoid raw $ numbers.

LaunchBot: Document created: drive:/marketing/launchpad-sparknotes/v1 — permissions: marketing,sales. Auto-tag: launch-collateral.

Priyanka: For inbound routing, proposing a short decision tree (AE cheat-sheet):
```
Compliance-first -> Private
Predictable high throughput -> Dedicated
Time-to-value / experiments -> Hosted API
```
Priyanka: I'll draft 3 email snippets for inbound routing and a short playbook.

Maya: Great. @Tomas pls ping Security for review of any FedRAMP language. Jen pls make two variants (concise field-card, expanded one-pager). We'll sync in 30m. Thanks! :thumbsup:
